cancellation.scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.

parity.scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.

playback.scope: Virtual frame-clock consumption with one held playing chunk and at most two worker-ready chunks; independent silent audio probe, no physical stem playback
playback.clock: First initial/recovery delivery anchors an epoch; every ordinary deadline advances by actual delivered frames / sample rate, including source rotations and late output
playback.virtual_starvation_interval_scope: Union of completed ordinary demands' deadline-to-ready intervals; any unfulfilled final demand is reported separately with readiness censored at workload stop

transport.scope: Requested times use the stream-state wall clock; receipts identify render callback boundaries. No sample-exact wall-time scheduling or click-free transport claim.

report.measurement_scope: Callback execution and PipeWire-reported driver-position clock timing; not measured end-to-end audio latency, per-stream xrun recovery or a complete graph xrun count.

coverage.scope: Independent silent audio probe streaming interval; no stem playback claim

audio.scope: Independent silent48k/stereo/256-frame probe. No actual stem playback, physical latency, DAC quality or complete graph-xrun inference.

frame_observation.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications; not physical presentation latency

coverage.minute_bin_scope: Complete 60-second UI-observation bins overlapping the workload; partial final UI bins are excluded

progress.exposure_scope: Sampled heartbeat exposure; spans end at recovery or workload stop, or remain open during the run

coverage.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications and initialized heartbeat with a 30-second unexposed budget; not physical presentation latency

ui.scope: Software Harness update/heartbeat, sampled exposure and frameSwapped gaps; not physical display timing or integrated stem-player qualification.

thermal.scope: All retained native-trace samples, including any startup/shutdown outside the stated workload span. 85C counts describe observations, not an added thermal pass gate. Consecutive spans and row brackets use timestamps recorded after capture, not precise sensor-read times. Capture-conservative brackets run from preceding below-threshold capture start to following below-threshold row timestamp; missing capture starts remain unavailable. Brackets describe sampled excursions, not continuous temperature or all unseen peaks; gaps are not filled or asserted safe.

native_trace_coverage.startup_scope: Native PID publication follows ready; this trace cannot observe native pre-ready startup. Relative trace/workload endpoints retain any setup or teardown samples.
native_trace_coverage.observer_scope: Capture wall time covers sampler reads, not trace writing or a measured overhead effect. Missing optional fields remain unavailable; read failures are retained separately from trace/sample errors.

source_acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
source_acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
source_acceptance.scope: prepared WAV corpus playback-paced delivery with requested load=both; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim

latency_gate.percentile_method: nearest rank; consecutive windows are not independent tail samples
latency_gate.scope: Diagnostic completion is independent of target success. Producer's existing floating-point target formula and strict comparison are retained; no threshold relaxation or full60-minute claim.

comparison.scope: Closed exact own-arm PCM/build/source admission. Current soak performs its existing within-run parity checks; no cross-arm identity or per-request frozen-PCM assertion.

execution_provenance.scope: Narrow launcher adaptation plus scoped nested-helper copies fixing handled-signal publication and known-group cleanup. Frozen originals, soak, worker, Harness and probe remain unchanged. No arbitrary SIGKILL immunity claim.

record.human_reply: Ready—minimized, AC connected, lid open; I’ll keep the test window visible and screen awake
record.scope: Fresh physical readiness for this600s diagnostic only. Codex minimized, AC connected, lid open and software Harness visible. Original human record must remain no older than900s at workload admission and cannot be renewed automatically.
